title: Procognitive restoration of PV neuron plasticity in neurodevelopmental disorders.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Downloaded GSE283741_RAW.tar (1.3 MB): 9 HTSeq gene-count files, each 37,625 lines (about 37,620 Ensembl mouse gene IDs plus 5 HTSeq summary rows), raw integer counts. The series matrix shows 9 samples: 5 shNT (control short hairpin RNA) and 4 shAblim3 (knock-down), all 'brain tissue', no other covariates. The XPG atlas website (xpg-atlas.onrender.com) is only a per-gene search box with autocomplete; I found no bulk download.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That the samples are TRAP (ribosome-tagging) pulldowns from CA3/CA2 PV interneurons; that differential expression was called with edgeR; that 82 SFARI category 1/S1 autism genes are among the upregulated genes (Supplementary Table 1, which I did not retrieve because the Europe PMC supplement request timed out).

a1_downloadable.note: GEO counts download openly (checked). The curated XPG list is only searchable gene by gene on the atlas site, and Supplementary Table 1 wasn't retrievable.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No gene-level label is in the files. The only candidate, 'is this gene an XPG (experience-dependent PV plasticity gene)', would have to be built by running a differential-expression test on these 9 count files.

a3_inputs_present.note: Ensembl gene IDs with raw counts are present (checked).

a4_units_stated.note: Raw HTSeq read counts per gene (checked); the unit is unambiguous.

a5_enough_rows.note: The unit of observation is the sample: 9 libraries, 5 control and 4 knock-down (checked). That is far too few for any sample-level model. Gene-level rows (~37,620) only exist if the label is derived from these same 9 samples.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: 9 GSM samples in GEO match the series design. The paper's DE gene counts can't be checked without Supplementary Table 1.

a8_label_provenance.note: A gene-level 'XPG' label would be an edgeR output computed from these same counts, so any features taken from this data would leak the label. Using it as a label for sequence-based models would mean learning one noisy n=9 contrast.

integration.partner_dataset: SFARI Gene / SCHEMA / Epi25 / BipEx (gene-level disease-risk lists, as used by the authors)
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Are genes induced in activated PV interneurons enriched for neurodevelopmental-disorder risk genes? The paper already answers this as an enrichment test, so it isn't an ML question.

controls.positive_control: Known activity-regulated genes (e.g. Fos, Npas4) should come out upregulated, though this was not checked.
controls.external_validation: None identified for this specific mossy-fibre-input contrast.

honest_claim_h3: With 9 TRAP-seq samples from one lab and one manipulation, a model could at most claim to rank genes by how much one shRNA perturbation changes their translation in CA3/CA2 PV interneurons, and that ranking is the paper's own DE result.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use gene features to predict which genes switch on when hippocampal inhibitory neurons get more excitatory input.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-gene features (sequence, function annotations) for ~37,620 mouse genes. Labels would come from 9 ribosome-pulldown RNA-seq samples (5 control, 4 knock-down), counts I verified.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a gene is significantly upregulated in activated PV (parvalbumin) interneurons, a label computed by differential-expression testing on the same 9 samples.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: It could flag plasticity genes in other neuron types. But the label is one noisy 9-sample contrast, so the result would not be trusted.

label_elsewhere.sources: None found. This mossy-fibre-input PV translatome contrast appears to be unique to this paper (not searched).
label_elsewhere.why: Without an external measurement of the same contrast, there is nothing to validate against.

ml_idea: Gene-level classifier of XPG status from sequence or annotation embeddings. Rejected: the label is a DE call from n=9 samples.

effort.compute_note: Sizes measured from the downloaded tar; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the samples in the GEO series matrix: 9. Done, and it kills the project.

verdict_reason: The only data is 9 TRAP-seq count files (5 control, 4 knock-down; checked), which is far too few samples (A5). Any gene-level label would be a differential-expression call computed from those same counts (A2, A8), and the curated XPG list has no bulk download.
